Some of his Twitch clips are already 9:16 (720x1280), so use --layout full for those.
Overlay (GTA 6, Nov 2026): small facecam at the top-left, plus his own live captions burned in at the bottom centre (y 0.89-0.97). Use --game 0,0,1,0.88 so they don't double up with ours.
Viewer clips download at 2560x1440 60 fps; the live feed tops out at 720p60.
